idea.idea_text: An AI-driven cybersecurity platform designed for small and medium-sized businesses. The system continuously monitors network traffic, user behavior, and system logs to detect cyber threats, phishing attacks, ransomware, and suspicious activities in real time. It provides automated incident response, security recommendations, and compliance reports, helping organizations strengthen their security posture without requiring a dedicated cybersecurity team.
